GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 410.2 (10 Sep 46) CPC/GP
(SCAPIN-1193)
APO 500
10 September 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
Subject : Purchase of Precious Metals.
1. Reference is made to the following:
a. Memorandum for the Imperial Japanese Government, file AG 130 (1 Mar. 46) ESS/FI, SCAPIN 637-A, subject: “Purchase and Sale of Precious Metals,” from General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers.
b. Memorandum for the Imperial Japanese Government file AG 123 (19 Jan. 46) ESS/FI, SCAPIN 620, subject: “Revision of the Purchase Price of Gold and Silver Payable by the Government,” from General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers.
c. Memorandum for the Imperial Japanese Government, file AG 410.2 (26 Apr. 46) CPC/GP, SCAPIN 1098-A. subject: “Reports of Precious Metals,” from General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers.
2 The Imperial Japanese Government is directed to purchase from producers, processors and other sources, all newly mined precious metals produced in Japan. Such Purchases will be accomplished through the Bank of Japan; prices to be paid will be those established in reference Memorandum 1b, above. Metals will be purchased by the last day of the month following that in which they were processed. Precious metals purchased will be deposited in the Bank of Japan and reports of quantities of metals purchased will be submitted to General Headquarers, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, in accordance with paragraph 4 of reference Memorandum 1c, above.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
